title: OMG, the swings!
content: They sit in a valley surrounded by grassy hills, no trees. No other typical playground equipment - just those damned swings. The vertical bars holding them up are well over 100’ tall. Easy to sit on the plain rubber seats at ground level, but after just one or two pumps you’re clearly in danger of almost going over the top. Absolutely terrifying and exhilarating at the same time. No control over slowing down.
